title: SubFlip – Subscription Aggregator
tagline: Smart subscription marketplace for managing, switching, & reselling plans.
description: Full-stack subscription management and marketplace aggregator that allows users to monitor active recurring subscriptions, switch or pause plans seamlessly, and monetize unused slots through a commission-based business model with automated Stripe/Razorpay payment integrations.
problem: Millions of users lose hundreds of dollars annually on unused subscriptions. No unified platform exists to track, manage, or monetize subscription slots across fragmented SaaS tools, creating user frustration and missed savings opportunities.
solution: Built SubFlip as a centralized hub for subscription management with real-time analytics, 1-click plan cancellation workflows, automated Stripe webhook synchronization, and a slot-sharing marketplace that enables users to monetize unused subscription capacity.
architecture_details: Used Prisma ORM for type-safe database queries across PostgreSQL tables
Built async queue handling with RabbitMQ to process payment webhooks reliably
Utilized Redis for caching high-frequency subscription metadata, cutting query latency by 90%
Containerized deployment environment with Docker for reproducible staging & production builds

challenges_solutions.title: Database Aggregation Query Latency
challenges_solutions.challenge: Aggregating active subscriptions across thousands of users initially took over 1.2s due to complex unindexed joins.
challenges_solutions.solution: Added composite PostgreSQL indices on user_id and renewal_date, combined with a Redis TTL caching layer for active subscription feeds, dropping query latency to under 20ms.

challenges_solutions.title: Webhook Synchronization Mismatches
challenges_solutions.challenge: Payment provider webhooks were occasionally delivered out of order or dropped during traffic bursts.
challenges_solutions.solution: Implemented an idempotent RabbitMQ event queue with exponential backoff retry mechanisms and dead-letter queue auditing to prevent double billing.

challenges_solutions.title: Commission Escrow Accuracy
challenges_solutions.challenge: Calculating multi-tier commission payouts for shared plan slots required strict transaction isolation.
challenges_solutions.solution: Designed deterministic database transactions with PostgreSQL row-level locks and full audit logging before releasing payout webhooks.

lessons_learned: Strict type-safety with TypeScript prevented ~40% of runtime bugs before deployment.
Idempotency in payment webhooks is essential when handling financial transactions.
Caching strategy needs to be designed alongside database schemas, not added as an afterthought.

detailed_features.technical: Custom calculation engine with automated payment gateway webhooks

detailed_features.title: Automated Webhook Synchronization
detailed_features.description: Instant payment status updates and subscription tier adjustment upon payment confirmation.
detailed_features.technical: Stripe & Razorpay API webhook handlers backed by RabbitMQ event queues

title: School ERP System
tagline: Enterprise multi-tenant educational institution management platform.
description: Engineered a production-ready, multi-tenant School Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) platform powering attendance tracking, automated fee invoicing, gradebook processing, and role-based permissions. Built with NestJS, Prisma ORM, RabbitMQ message queues for async notification processing, and containerized via Docker.
problem: Legacy school management solutions struggle with data isolation across multi-campus setups and crash under concurrent end-of-term grade publishing and invoice generation loads.
solution: Architected a multi-tenant backend infrastructure with tenant-isolated database schemas, asynchronous event-driven task queues using RabbitMQ, and stress-tested under 50,000+ simulated concurrent requests.
architecture_details: Tenant schema separation ensuring zero cross-tenant data leakage
NestJS dependency injection & modular service architecture
RabbitMQ task queues for deferred PDF generation & bulk notification broadcasting
Docker Compose orchestration for DB, RabbitMQ, and API microservices

challenges_solutions.title: Multi-Campus Data Isolation
challenges_solutions.challenge: Preventing data leakage between different institutions hosted on the same infrastructure.
challenges_solutions.solution: Implemented dynamic schema connection middleware in NestJS that binds every incoming HTTP request to its respective tenant DB context.

challenges_solutions.title: End-of-Term Report Card Spikes
challenges_solutions.challenge: Simultaneous bulk grade processing caused CPU throttling and HTTP request timeouts.
challenges_solutions.solution: Offloaded report rendering to asynchronous RabbitMQ worker tasks, notifying parents via WebSockets when PDFs were ready.

lessons_learned: NestJS modules significantly improve developer velocity and code maintainability in enterprise systems.
Isolating heavy background jobs via message queues protects primary API endpoints from latency degradation.

detailed_features.title: Multi-Tenant Schema Router
detailed_features.description: Strict data isolation with dynamic database connection routing per institution.
detailed_features.technical: NestJS guards & dynamic Prisma client connection pooling

detailed_features.title: Automated Fee & Invoicing Engine
detailed_features.description: Automated breakdown calculations, PDF receipt generation, and payment gateway webhooks.
detailed_features.technical: RabbitMQ async workers and PDF-Lib rendering pipeline

detailed_features.description: Granular authorization supporting SuperAdmin, Principal, Teacher, Student, and Parent roles.
detailed_features.technical: Custom NestJS JWT Passport guards and role bitmasks

title: Hospital Management System (HMS)
tagline: End-to-end clinical workflow and patient record management system.
description: Collaborative full-stack healthcare platform built with Node.js/Express, PostgreSQL, and Prisma ORM in partnership with Prisha. Streamlines doctor appointment scheduling, electronic medical records (EMR), bed allocation, and pharmacy inventory with full CRUD operations and strict data compliance.
problem: Manual hospital record-keeping leads to fragmented patient histories, appointment scheduling conflicts, and billing discrepancies across clinical departments.
solution: Developed a relational PostgreSQL data model with atomic database transactions, conflict-free appointment booking locks, and intuitive role-based clinical dashboards.
architecture_details: Relational PostgreSQL schema with foreign keys and cascade constraints
Prisma ORM transactions (`$transaction`) for multi-step billing and booking integrity
Role-based middleware ensuring strict HIPPA-inspired medical record privacy

challenges_solutions.title: Double-Booking Prevention
challenges_solutions.challenge: Simultaneous appointment requests for popular doctors caused booking overlaps.
challenges_solutions.solution: Implemented PostgreSQL row locking (`SELECT FOR UPDATE`) within Prisma transactions to ensure serial execution during booking slots.

challenges_solutions.title: Patient EMR Timeline Aggregation
challenges_solutions.challenge: Combining diagnoses, lab results, and prescriptions into a unified timeline was slow.
challenges_solutions.solution: Created optimized SQL joins and indexed patient IDs, reducing medical history load time to <50ms.

lessons_learned: Atomic database transactions are critical when handling healthcare schedules and financial billing.
Designing clean data models early simplifies complex frontend dashboard rendering.

title: ZyMeal – Food Ordering API & App
tagline: Scalable food ordering and real-time order tracking backend API & web app.
description: Built a complete food ordering backend and web application using Node.js, Express.js, React, and MongoDB with separate logins for users, admin, products, and orders using JWT and bcrypt for password security. Features real-time order status updates using Socket.io and secured API endpoints with Helmet.js, rate limiting, and Zod-based input validation.
problem: Traditional food delivery APIs experience latency spikes during peak checkout windows and lack real-time status synchronization between kitchens and customers.
solution: Engineered a scalable Node.js/Express.js backend utilizing Socket.io for live order status updates, MVC patterns for codebase modularity, and Zod/Helmet.js for complete API reinforcement.
architecture_details: MongoDB database with Mongoose ODM modeling users, products, and orders
Socket.io WebSocket server broadcasting real-time kitchen status events
Zod schema validation middleware sanitizing all incoming HTTP payloads
JWT authentication with refresh tokens and HTTP-only cookie security

challenges_solutions.title: Real-Time Order Tracking Sync
challenges_solutions.challenge: Polling database for order status updates created excessive DB load during peak meal hours.
challenges_solutions.solution: Replaced HTTP polling with Socket.io WebSockets room events (`order:{id}`), delivering instant status pushes with zero redundant DB reads.

challenges_solutions.title: Checkout Request Throttling
challenges_solutions.challenge: Malicious script spamming checkout endpoints caused order creation surges.
challenges_solutions.solution: Implemented express-rate-limit and Zod input validation guards to block malformed requests before hitting database layers.

lessons_learned: WebSockets dramatically reduce database load compared to REST polling for live state updates.
Input validation at the API edge (Zod) eliminates entire classes of injection vulnerabilities.

title: GitFC – EA FC-Style GitHub Card Generator
tagline: Transform your GitHub profile into EA FC Ultimate Team style cards.
description: Interactive web application that fetches live GitHub contribution metrics via GraphQL and calculates a custom developer rating engine. Translates commits, pull requests, stars, and activity streaks into EA FC-inspired attributes (PAS, DRI, SHO, PAC, DEF, PHY) with dynamic card shells and 1-click HD card export.
problem: Standard GitHub profile visualizers are static, text-heavy, and lack engaging gamified metrics for showcasing developer achievements.
solution: Engineered an algorithmic rating engine mapping real GitHub activity into EA FC player attributes with dynamic card rarity rendering (TOTY, Icon, Gold) and instant high-res PNG export.
architecture_details: GitHub GraphQL API integration for fetching total commits, PRs, code reviews, and star counts
Custom mathematical normalization engine mapping raw activity to 0-99 FIFA player attributes
Client-side HTML2Canvas image rendering pipeline for instant HD card download

challenges_solutions.title: GitHub API Rate Limits
challenges_solutions.challenge: REST API endpoints triggered rate limits rapidly during viral traffic spikes.
challenges_solutions.solution: Migrated query layer to GitHub GraphQL API, bundling 6 REST requests into 1 single optimized GraphQL payload.

lessons_learned: GraphQL drastically reduces payload size and eliminates over-fetching from public APIs.
Gamification makes developer profile metrics shareable and engaging.

title: IHateLovePDF – All-in-One PDF Suite
description: All-in-one PDF utility platform designed to split, merge, compress, convert, edit, unlock, and protect PDF files directly in the browser with maximum security and sub-second processing speeds. Eliminates payload limits and privacy risks.
problem: Traditional PDF tools enforce strict payload limits, push aggressive subscription paywalls, and compromise data privacy by uploading sensitive documents to remote cloud servers.
solution: Engineered a high-speed, client-first web suite leveraging WebAssembly & Web Workers for 100% private, zero-latency PDF operations directly inside the user's browser.
architecture_details: Client-side PDF-Lib & WebAssembly WASM engine executing document mutations in-browser
Web Workers background thread processing to keep main UI smooth at 60 FPS
Zero server file uploads, ensuring 100% GDPR-compliant data privacy

challenges_solutions.title: Browser Thread Freezing
challenges_solutions.challenge: Merging heavy 200MB+ PDF documents froze the browser main UI thread.
challenges_solutions.solution: Offloaded PDF binary manipulation to background Web Workers, updating progress bars via postMessage events.

lessons_learned: Client-side WASM processing eliminates backend server bandwidth and computing costs entirely.
Privacy-first architecture builds immediate user trust.

title: SwipeRide – Ride Sharing API
tagline: Real-time geospatial ride-sharing and driver matching engine.
description: Building a real-time ride-sharing backend using Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, JWT (for rider/driver/admin roles), Socket.io (live tracking), and Redis (fast driver location tracking). Used Google Maps API for fare calculation, Paystack for payments, and MongoDB's geospatial queries to find nearby drivers with dynamic radius expansion.
problem: Matching riders with nearby drivers in real-time requires high-frequency database reads and spatial calculations that degrade standard relational SQL performance.
solution: Built a high-performance matching engine using MongoDB's geospatial queries with dynamic radius expansion, cached active driver locations in Redis for ultra-low latency updates, and synced status over Socket.io.
architecture_details: MongoDB 2DSphere spatial index for `$near` coordinate queries
Redis Geo spatial caching for sub-millisecond driver ping updates
Socket.io room broadcasting for driver location pings
Google Maps Distance Matrix API for dynamic fare calculation

challenges_solutions.title: High-Frequency Driver Pings
challenges_solutions.challenge: Drivers sending GPS coordinates every 3 seconds saturated MongoDB write queues.
challenges_solutions.solution: Cached driver coordinates directly in Redis GEO key-value store, writing back to MongoDB only upon trip completion.

lessons_learned: Redis GEO data structures are immensely faster for transient spatial location tracking than disk-backed databases.
Decoupling transient GPS streams from persistent database models prevents API bottlenecks.

detailed_features.description: Instant matching with nearest available drivers using dynamic radius expansion.
detailed_features.technical: MongoDB 2DSphere indexing & Redis GEO queries
